note: Public crypto Telegram channels and groups read by CryptoPulse. kind=channel: read on the phone and in the cloud hub via the t.me/s web preview (no login). kind=group: read by the cloud hub through the user's own Telegram account (by username, without joining). Compiled from web research on 2026-10-19; confidence < 0.6 means memory-only. Handles that fail are skipped at runtime. Categories meme_project (official memecoin channels, many are verification portals with little text), dex_trending (paid trending slots: counted as mentions, weighted low in sentiment) and listings were added on 2026-10-19 from CoinGecko, Trust Wallet and tonkeeper data.
